# Setup
```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, brms, tidybayes, cmdstanr, emmeans, arrow, rio, janitor, ape)

```

# Load models and data
```{r}
# load model
m11d_co100_zln = readRDS(file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/unified_model_results_zln_m11d_co100_20260926_174424_with_loo.rds"))
model_select = m11d_co100_zln

# load life history
ls_in = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "iucn_habitat_metrics.csv"))

ls_clean = ls_in %>%
  mutate(log_habitat_breadth = log(habitat_breadth))

# phylogenetic tree
jp_phylo_tree = read.tree(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "phylo_tree.nwk"))
# correlation matrix (diag = 1) so sd_taxon_capture is on the same scale as sigma
# and the phylogenetic signal hypotheses below read as Pagel's lambda
jp_phylo_cov = ape::vcv.phylo(jp_phylo_tree, corr = TRUE)

set_cmdstan_path(Sys.getenv("cmd_stan_path"))
```

# linpred draws
```{r}
mmode = function(x) {
  ux = unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}


# define linpred data
nd_env_subadult = model_select$data %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
  summarize(precip_mm_10_z = median(precip_mm_10_z),
            temp_c_30_z = median(temp_c_30_z),
            kg_code_3 = mmode(kg_code_3),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(life_stage_simple == "subadult")

nd_spp_lss = model_select$data |>
  distinct(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
  left_join(nd_env_subadult %>%
              select(-life_stage_simple), by = "taxon_capture")

# include taxon-specific env slopes (fixed + r_taxon_capture) so each species' linpred
# at its median env uses its own slopes, not the population-average slopes.
# contrasts are unaffected (slopes do not vary by life stage).
re_spp_env = ~ (0 + precip_mm_10_z + temp_c_30_z + I(temp_c_30_z^2) | taxon_capture)

# hu contrast
hu_spp_lss_draws = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata    = nd_spp_lss,
    dpar       = "hu",
    re_formula = re_spp_env
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# mu 
mu_spp_lss_draws = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata    = nd_spp_lss,
    dpar       = "mu",
    re_formula = re_spp_env
  ) %>% ungroup()

# combine
spp_lss_draws = hu_spp_lss_draws %>%
  select(taxon_capture,
         life_stage_simple,
         .draw,
         hu) %>%
  left_join(mu_spp_lss_draws %>%
              select(taxon_capture,
                     life_stage_simple,
                     .draw,
                     mu), by = c("taxon_capture", "life_stage_simple", ".draw"))

```

# calculate metrics
```{r}
spp_contrast_agg = spp_lss_draws %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("taxon_capture", ".draw"),
              names_from = "life_stage_simple",
              values_from = c("hu", "mu")) %>%
  mutate(contrast = "subadult - adult",
         hu_contrast = hu_subadult - hu_adult,
         mu_contrast = mu_subadult - mu_adult) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(contrast = dplyr::first(contrast),
            hu_contrast_mean = mean(hu_contrast),
            hu_contrast_sd = sd(hu_contrast),
            mu_contrast_mean = mean(mu_contrast),
            mu_contrast_sd = sd(mu_contrast),
            .groups = "drop")

metrics_agg = spp_contrast_agg

# mu contrast is only estimable where both life stages have Bd-positive loads;
# mu_contrast_mean is fit with subset(has_mu_contrast) below
mu_resp = as.character(model_select$formula$formula[[2]])

taxa_mu_contrast = model_select$data |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) |>
  summarise(n_pos = sum(.data[[mu_resp]] > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(taxon_capture) |>
  filter(n_distinct(life_stage_simple) == 2, all(n_pos > 0)) |>
  distinct(taxon_capture) |>
  pull(taxon_capture)

metrics_ls = metrics_agg %>%
  left_join(ls_clean, by = "taxon_capture") %>%
  mutate(has_mu_contrast = taxon_capture %in% taxa_mu_contrast)

metrics_ls %>%
  filter(!has_mu_contrast) %>%
  pull(taxon_capture)  # mu contrast not estimable

```

# checks
```{r}
# Names in your covariance matrix
mat_names = rownames(jp_phylo_cov)

# Names in your data
data_names = unique(metrics_ls$taxon_capture)

# Check for mismatches
setdiff(data_names, mat_names)  # in data but not matrix
setdiff(mat_names, data_names)  # in matrix but not data

# within-species correlation of estimation error between the two contrasts.
# se() treats each response's sd as independent; this is justified if |r| is small.
# the hurdle likelihood shares no parameters between hu and mu, so r should be near 0
spp_error_cor = spp_lss_draws %>%
  filter(taxon_capture %in% taxa_mu_contrast) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("taxon_capture", ".draw"),
              names_from = "life_stage_simple",
              values_from = c("hu", "mu")) %>%
  mutate(hu_contrast = hu_subadult - hu_adult,
         mu_contrast = mu_subadult - mu_adult) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(r_hucontrast_mucontrast = cor(hu_contrast, mu_contrast),
            .groups = "drop")

summary(spp_error_cor$r_hucontrast_mucontrast)

ggplot(spp_error_cor, aes(x = r_hucontrast_mucontrast, y = reorder(taxon_capture, r_hucontrast_mucontrast))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Within-species posterior correlation (hu contrast, mu contrast)", y = NULL)
```

# Model
```{r}
# measurement error via se(sd, sigma = TRUE): y ~ N(mu, sqrt(sigma^2 + sd^2)).
# equivalent to mi(sd) on the response, but integrates out the latent true values
# so log_lik is per observation and LOO is valid

# subset() on mu_contrast_mean gives responses different numbers of observations,
# so brms can only compute LOO (and R2) one response at a time. moment matching fails
# for models with subset() (brms 2.23), so check pareto k and use reloo/kfold if needed
loo_by_resp = function(fit) {
  resps = fit$formula$responses
  setNames(map(resps, ~ loo(fit, resp = .x)), resps)
}

m1_lspr = brm(
  mvbf(
    hu_contrast_mean | se(hu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    mu_contrast_mean | se(mu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) + subset(has_mu_contrast) ~ habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    rescor = FALSE
  ),
  data  = metrics_ls,
  data2 = list(A = jp_phylo_cov),
  # control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  seed = 124,
  cores = 4,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)

m1_lspr$criteria$loo_resp = loo_by_resp(m1_lspr)

saveRDS(m1_lspr, file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1_lspr.rds"))
m1_lspr = readRDS(file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1_lspr.rds"))

m1b_lspr = brm(
  mvbf(
    hu_contrast_mean | se(hu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    mu_contrast_mean | se(mu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) + subset(has_mu_contrast) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    rescor = FALSE
  ),
  data  = metrics_ls,
  data2 = list(A = jp_phylo_cov),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)

m1b_lspr$criteria$loo_resp = loo_by_resp(m1b_lspr)

saveRDS(m1b_lspr, file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1b_lspr.rds"))
m1b_lspr = readRDS(file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1b_lspr.rds"))

# include development mode
m1d_lspr = brm(
  mvbf(
    bf(hu_contrast_mean | se(hu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + development_stage + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
       family = gaussian()),
    bf(mu_contrast_mean | se(mu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) + subset(has_mu_contrast) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + development_stage + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
       family = gaussian()),
    rescor = FALSE
  ),
  data  = metrics_ls,
  data2 = list(A = jp_phylo_cov),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)

m1d_lspr$criteria$loo_resp = loo_by_resp(m1d_lspr)

saveRDS(m1d_lspr, file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1d_lspr.rds"))
m1d_lspr = readRDS(file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1d_lspr.rds"))

```

# model comparison
```{r}
# compare models within each response
(loo_comp_out = map(set_names(m1d_lspr$formula$responses), function(resp) {
  loo_compare(list(m1_lspr  = m1_lspr$criteria$loo_resp[[resp]],
                   m1b_lspr = m1b_lspr$criteria$loo_resp[[resp]],
                   m1d_lspr = m1d_lspr$criteria$loo_resp[[resp]]))
}))

map(set_names(m1d_lspr$formula$responses), ~ bayes_R2(m1d_lspr, resp = .x))
```

# model evaluation
```{r}
model_select = m1d_lspr
summary(model_select)
plot((model_select), ask = FALSE)
plot(conditional_effects(model_select), ask = FALSE)
VarCorr(model_select)

# phylogenetic signal per response: sd_phylo^2 / (sd_phylo^2 + sigma^2)
# (mv model has per-response sd and sigma; sigma excludes the known se)
hyp_mu_contrast = paste("sd_taxon_capture__mucontrastmean_Intercept^2 /",
             "(sd_taxon_capture__mucontrastmean_Intercept^2 + sigma_mucontrastmean^2) = 0")
hyp_hu_contrast = paste("sd_taxon_capture__hucontrastmean_Intercept^2 /",
             "(sd_taxon_capture__hucontrastmean_Intercept^2 + sigma_hucontrastmean^2) = 0")

# all responses in one table
hypothesis(model_select, c(hu_contrast = hyp_hu_contrast,
                           mu_contrast = hyp_mu_contrast), class = NULL)

ht_hu_contrast = hypothesis(model_select, hyp_hu_contrast, class = NULL)
ht_mu_contrast = hypothesis(model_select, hyp_mu_contrast, class = NULL)

ht_hu_contrast
ht_mu_contrast

# correlation between hu and mu contrasts across species (phylogenetic random effect).
# limitation: the hurdle cutoff can mechanically couple the two contrasts
cor_contrasts = as_draws_df(model_select, variable = "^cor_taxon_capture__", regex = TRUE) |>
  posterior::summarise_draws("median", ~ quantile(.x, probs = c(0.025, 0.25, 0.75, 0.975)))

cor_contrasts
```

# visualize
```{r}
m_fixed_draws = model_select %>%
  gather_draws(`b_.*`, regex = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!grepl("Intercept", .variable)) %>%
  separate(.variable, into = c("prefix", "response", "term"),
           sep = "_", extra = "merge")

ggplot(m_fixed_draws, aes(x = .value, y = term, color = response, fill = response)) +
  stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.6, .width = c(0.5, 0.89), density = "bounded", normalize = "panels") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ response, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Posterior estimate", y = NULL,
       title = "Fixed effects across responses",
       fill = NULL,
       color = NULL)
```
